<% if (req.locals.domain.param) { %>
<% for (var name in req.locals.domain.param) { %> <param name="<%= name %>" value="<%= req.locals.domain.param[name] %>"/> <% } %>
<% } %> <% if (req.locals.domain.variable) { %>
<% for (var name in req.locals.domain.variable) { %> <variable name="<%= name %>" value="<%= req.locals.domain.variable[name] %>"/> <% } %>
<% } %> <% if (req.locals.groups) { var users = {}; %>
<% for (group in req.locals.groups) { %> <group name="<%= group %>"> <% if (req.locals.groups[group].param) { %>
<% for (var name in req.locals.groups[group].param) { %> <param name="<%= name %>" value="<%= req.locals.groups[group].param[name] %>"/> <% } %>
<% } %> <% if (req.locals.groups[group].variable) { %>
<% for (var name in req.locals.groups[group].variable) { %> <variable name="<%= name %>" value="<%= req.locals.groups[group].variable[name] %>"/> <% } %>
<% } %> <% if (req.locals.groups[group].users) { %>
<% for (var user in req.locals.groups[group].users) { %> <% if (users[user]) { %> <user id="<%= user %>" type="pointer"/> <% } else { users[user] = true; %> <user id="<%= user %>"> <% if (req.locals.users[user].param) { %>
<% for (var name in req.locals.users[user].param) { %> <param name="<%= name %>" value="<%= req.locals.users[user].param[name] %>"/> <% } %>
<% } %> <% if (req.locals.users[user].variable) { %>
<% for (var name in req.locals.users[user].variable) { %> <variable name="<%= name %>" value="<%= req.locals.users[user].variable[name] %>"/> <% } %>
<% } %>
<% } %> <% } %>
<% } %>
<% } %>
<% } %>
